content: Written 2026-10-07 20:18. Real row 4 S3 form, the full chain A -> B -> C in one run from scratch (one code path for every session), code 29d7f6e. Flags: --backend game --row 4 --core l2 --d1 --g8-holdout --session-keyframes --no-closed-background --dataset real. No S4, no N1, no ray band; GaME's published end-of-run refinement after C (F2); eval SES 'a b c', pre_ref and post_ref.

Form by source (supervisor 20:28, originals): the fork's cross-session structure -- session_refusion.cpp:97-100 'The session's frames as the present sees them: the archived range ...' (the present from this session's frames only), :891 step 2 builds the PresentTsdf from them, :1512-1517 step 6 'New surface = the present, then (memory as the previous final map showed it) the shown memory faces': earlier sessions' frames are never re-integrated; their information enters as the previous final map's elements. The 3DGS counterpart: the carried Gaussians are the previous final map, this session's keyframes train it (S3). KinectFusion Eq. 10-12 describes the within-session running average, not this cross-session structure (my 20:12 reading withdrawn). --no-closed-background: README line 331, the closed-object background re-tests the TSDF's background copy of an object; 3DGS elements carry one identity.
no new quantity; GaME flat.yaml as published (keyframe_iters 50, refinement_iters 30000).
eval_row.sh unchanged; rows 1/3 compared like-for-like (pre_ref with pre_ref, post_ref with post_ref).
the S3 path ran in v7/v9 (B) and v7 (A); the code since adds only switches that are off here (RB, depth_scale_online) and removed --no-refine.
A ~15 min, B ~22 min, C ~45 min, refinement + evals ~30 min; disk 317 GB used inside.

B keyframes explained by the map: S3 form (v10) 91.2 %, RB2 88.1 %, row 1 87.0 %; first-echo memory explained by B: S3 92.2 %, RB2 87.5 % (analysis/unexplained_split*, echo_origin*). Prior official B G1 of the S3 form without S4/N1 (v9, 92.35) is a reading, not the selection criterion.
